summary.text: Kimberly Berfield is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 58, elected in 2022.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Berfield previously served in the House from 2000 to 2006 and was Deputy Secretary of the Florida Department of Health from 2006 to 2012.
Berfield lives in Clearwater, is a business executive, holds a B.A. from the University of Central Florida and an M.B.A. from Northeastern University, and was born in Houston, Texas.
